host.runtimeLayout: Self-contained PowerShell host; installation prefix omitted. Timing samples are unchanged.

scope: Separate diagnostic processes include startup, import and repeated exact packet probes. They are not the unprofiled timing samples. Percentages in text exports include waiting threads and are not latency speedups.
reproduction: For each recorded workload, launch its verified manifest under: dotnet-trace collect --profile dotnet-sampled-thread-time --duration 00:00:00:12 --output profile.nettrace -- pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -File ./Benchmarks/PowerShellCompilation/Corpus/Invoke-ModuleProfileProbe.ps1 -ManifestPath <verified-manifest.psd1> -ModuleId <recorded-id> -Calls <requestedProbeCalls>. Add -Reimport for the PSFramework import sequence. Then run: dotnet-trace report profile.nettrace topN --number 160 --inclusive --verbose. This reproduces the recorded procedure; collection may stop before all requested calls complete.
